request.deadline: Three-month staged launch-liquidity deployment after enactment; monthly reporting is stated, but total delivery deadline is not stated in document.
deliverables: BTC reserve architecture with transparent safety mechanisms and reserve-ratio rules
Composable Cardano-native FIRE and ICE assets backed by a shared BTC reserve
Open-source SDKs and adapters for wallets, DEXs, and DeFi protocols
Always-on public dashboards for reserve ratio, asset supply, liquidity health, fee flows, and deployment status
Monthly governance reports and BTCfi reporting standards
Independent security review, audit, and economic modeling
Legal, compliance, disclosures, treasury reporting, risk documentation, and launch-readiness review
Staged treasury-supported launch liquidity with profits, yield, and returns returned to the Cardano Treasury quarterly
request.recipient: Sundial Protocol and Charms, with Intersect proposed as interim fund administrator subject to confirmation and final agreement.
request.what: Fund Alchemy, a Cardano-native Bitcoin treasury protocol and BTCfi infrastructure layer by Sundial Protocol and Charms.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 10,000,000 ada, using an approximate USD 0.20 per ada reference value for an approximately USD 2.0 million planning budget.

The budget is split into two approximately USD 1.0 million pools: one for protocol infrastructure and staged launch liquidity, and one for delivery, audits, integrations, dashboards, governance reporting, legal/compliance work, and go-to-market execution.

Alchemy will create a shared BTC reserve architecture where FIRE and ICE are backed by the same BTC reserve, with reserve-ratio formulas and safety zones above 4.0x, between 2.0x and 4.0x, and below 2.0x.

FIRE is described as a volatility-absorbing residual BTC-upside asset and ICE as a lower-volatility USD-denominated BTC-backed asset, both intended to circulate as composable Cardano-native primitives.

The launch-liquidity pool will be deployed in three monthly tranches of approximately USD 250,000, USD 250,000, and USD 500,000 after audit, reporting, operational, threshold, reserve-ratio, growth-rate, and dashboard checks.

All profits, yield, and returns generated by the treasury-supported launch liquidity position will be returned to the Cardano Treasury quarterly, converted into ada through Cardano-native DEXs with methodology disclosed in monthly reports.

The proposal states that launch-liquidity principal may be returned after Alchemy reaches at least USD 60 million 30-day time-weighted average TVL, subject to a formal governance proposal for DRep and Constitutional Committee review.

The proposal claims Cardano currently lacks a production BTCfi infrastructure layer and that failing to fund Alchemy would leave Bitcoin-backed structured exposure consolidating on other chains and off-chain markets.

The proposal cites Strategy, Strive, Apyx, Saturn, and Pendle as evidence that Bitcoin-backed structured exposure is a real and growing market, with specific Strategy and Strive figures tied to external references or dated assertions.

The proposal acknowledges BTC volatility, oracle, bridge, Charms protocol-layer, novel asset, delivery, and adoption risks, and proposes mitigations including overcollateralization, independent review, modeling, staged deployment, dashboards, pause rules, legal/compliance work, reporting, and administrator oversight.

summary: The document describes a 10,000,000 ada treasury withdrawal for a Cardano BTCfi infrastructure package with two budget pools, staged launch liquidity, FIRE/ICE assets, reserve mechanics, audits, dashboards, reporting, administrator oversight, and stated treasury-return protections.
